reviews.x: My hair is extremely thick and curly. I had high hopes for this based on reviews, but knowing my hair they were realistically high, and somewhat doubtful. This product is easy to use, strongly made, and cuts my straightening time at least in half. Great product definitely recommend. Glad I bought this brush.

UPDATE: Since writing the previous five star review, the straightener stopped turning on after maybe ten uses. Currently in the process of seeking a refund.  I'm surprisingly pleased. I have long wavy (3A) hair. And it's thick. Super thick. Like, "I have to make my own ponytail holders because the regular ones aren't big enough" thick. And I live in Houston where our humidity can best be described as "lol good luck." Suffice to say, it's a little bit of a problem especially, duri

[[VIDEOID:f17e41918c145b800074f16c92d0e0c6]] Love, love, love this brush! It came packaged in an adorable brush. The instructions were pretty short and simple, so it wasn't too overwhelming. Some user manuals can seem like a textbook. You do have to hold the power button down for about 3 seconds for it to turn on and off. My first time using this, I didn't do it right. They do say in the instructions to hold your hair straight and use small sections while straightening but it didn't really click

reviews.t: Very effective and easy to use
reviews.x: I have been wanting one of these for awhile and finally decided to give it a shot and was very happy with my results. I have Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in my hands which makes squeezing objects difficult, especially for a prolonged amount of time. My Wet-2-Straight flat iron that I normally use causes me terrible pain in my hands, so this brush type straightener is a miracle for me. It doesn't hurt to use it and it is super easy.  I was afraid that since I have thick hair it would not help much but

Update 7/2017 Incredibly disappointed. Below is my original review. Since that time, I have uses the product less than 5 times before it stopped working. I was originally very pleased with it, but now there is something wrong with the wiring. Shortly after turning it on, it will shut off and it's not from accidentally hitting the off button. That is also another flaw of this product, you can easily accidentally turn it off.  Not worth the money.  Old review in case mine is one of the rare defect

I was very hesitant to buy this product, especially because it was so cheap, I honestly had very little hope that it would straighten my hair. My hair is very thick and long so I was super excited to try it and to my surprise, it worked! It works even better than my $250 CHI. I an very satisfied!

reviews.t: I opened the box and it looked like it had been used and put back in the ...
reviews.x: I bought this for my daughter.  I opened the box and it looked like it had been used and put back in the box. The power cord wasn't wrapped but the twist tie was hanging on the cord.  The white cord had several scuff marks on it. These pics are literally minutes after opening the box.

reviews.t: Amazed! Dont use flat iron anymore!
reviews.x: I'm addicted to this hot brush and no need for flat iron anymore. Was very surprised at performance for such a small amount of money! Hope it continues to work. I WILL purchase another though if it stops working. So easy to use and frizz? None!

reviews.t: Difficult to glide through hair and has a strange smell
reviews.x: Mine had a very strange chemical like smell whenever I turned it on and it was very difficult to glide through my hair (And I have pretty fine hair).
Returned item not happy with purchase, used twice, The brush would not turn back on and it does not heat up properly.
Too large to handle effectively.  Did not straighten as I would have expected even after several passes.
You're better off with the traditional hair straightener.

reviews.t: I think they are on to something here.
reviews.x: I have long, fine, wavy/frizzy hair. I can do most straightening with the dryer but I was wanting something that would give it that sleek shiny straight look without using product that makes my hair look greasy. I ordered this because i have tried everything else, why not this. Right out of the box i knew they were on to something here. A bit heavy, but nothing more than a hairdryer. I tried "brushing" my hair with it, bad idea. It yanked my hair out bad. The rubber bristles snag hair ve

I love the product and concept of quick, easy and straight.  But I am really fed up trying to turn it on!!  It worked after trying to figure out how to turn it on the first time(directions are super small print and hard to find), but trying to turn it on again has been further frustrating!  I recommend a simple KNOB power button!  Also, it may help keep it on without accidentally pressing it off, another concept failure in my opinion.  The placing is wrong.  Why put controls where your hands and

The up/down buttons are in a dangerous place, where your fingers are, so I kept hitting the up button and the temperature climbs fast! The entire brush is big, heavy and awkward to use. You have to push both the up and down button at the same time to get the temp to read in fahrenheit for americans. You have to do it each time you use it too. If you have thick, strong hair and it can handle high heat, you may like this. It does heat up quickly. I have tiny, frail thin hair so it was dangerous fo

reviews.t: Please do not purchase this product !
reviews.x: I was very excited to get my new hair brush straightener because I have heard many good things about it . I received the product today and as soon as I got it I wanted to try it out . I plugged the hair brush in and pressed the power button , but nothing was happening . I decided to go and plug it in , in a different outlet but it still would not turn on . I received a broken product and I do not recommend for anyone to waste their money on a product like this .

reviews.t: A traditional flat iron is far better
reviews.x: This product did not meet my expectations at all. You must hold your hair very tightly in order for it to straighten and even then it doesn't straighten that well. I have thin and relatively straight hair already, just like to give it a more finished look and this product failed. My flat iron does far better and faster than this. Maybe someone with thick curly hair it would work better but I honestly doubt it considering how hard I had to try.

This arrived without any instructions, I turned it on and it seems to heat up fine but it will snag your hair something awful when trying to brush it with this. I have 4 small children, I don't need a straightener to pull my hair too. I have long medium course hair. To good to be true. I'll wait for someone to perfect this concept and purchase then.... Going back!

reviews.t: everything was fine. I'd definitely recommend this to my friends
reviews.x: Although I was hesitant at first to buy this, I don't regret it. For me it was a lot easier to use than a flat iron and quicker as well. Only complaint I have is the placement of the buttons since I kept pressing them by accident while doing my hair. Other than that, everything was fine. I'd definitely recommend this to my friends.

Was REALLY skeptical but it works great on my curly hair!!! I love it. Heats up really quickly with adjustable precise heat (not just low, medium, high, you select the degrees) doesn't feel cheap or pull my *thick* hair. My only problem with it is that it is heavy, so it is a good thing it is faster than my lightweight flat iron.

reviews.t: Takes the frizz out of straight hair too!
reviews.x: I have never written a product review before I felt complelled to write thisone. My hair is already straight but I have to flat iron it anyway because it is frizzy looking if I don't.  This brush takes out all the frizz without having to flatiron it.  It saves me soooo much time and makes my hair so soft.  Great product!

The first few times I used this I wasn't very impressed, HOWEVER if you turn it on and let it heat up for about 10 minutes it gets super hot and works like a dream. I have wavy fine thick hair. I'm not sure how well it would work on curly coarse hair though. Can't beat the price to find out!

I was only able to use this straightener once. Before I was done, it kept turning off and I would have to turn it back on and mess with the cord for it to come back on. The next time I went to use it, it wouldn't even turn on at all. Save your money and skip on this purchase.

Greatest product I've ever used. I have super thick hair so it is always so difficult to do my hair. It usually takes me at least an hour to straighten my hair with a typical straightener. It took me just over 30 minutes to do it using this brush! I love it!

reviews.t: I was disappointed, this barely straightened and didn't even knock off ...
reviews.x: I was disappointed, this barely straightened and didn't even knock off the little bit of frizz in my hair. I have long, wavy hair that fixes easily and this didn't work well at all.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush easy to use and effective at straightening thick or curly hair, often saving time compared to flat irons.
Several reviewers report the device stopped working after only a few uses, with some seeking refunds.
Some reviewers find the brush too large, heavy, or awkward to handle, and difficult to glide through hair.
A few reviewers complain about difficulty turning the device on or confusing controls/instructions.
Some reviewers received items that appeared used or had issues like strange smells.
